about: Farnham is a city in Montérégie, Quebec, on the Yamaska River at the western edge of the Eastern Townships, southeast of Montréal. A railway and military-training heritage, a walkable core, and surrounding farm country define this small city—not a rural parish. About 10,000 people live in Farnham.
